notes: Considering — BOB's current flagship all-terrain jogger and the in-stock successor to the base Alterrain. SmoothShox suspension plus an ergonomic hand brake for downhill control; flattest fold of the three (33 × 21.5 × 13 in) though heaviest (32.3 lb). Shares the Alterrain's brand-specific adapter ecosystem, so any car seat marked 'fits Alterrain' fits the Pro. Best in-stock price $829.99 (Bambi Baby / Strolleria; Modern Nursery $879.99) — note this is OVER the $800 module budget. MSRP $829.99.
